boundary_evidence: WHOLE UNIT. build/tu_map.json ov006 calls 0x020c8a30..0x020c8dd4 one contiguous linker run of 10 functions with no class label; the 10 symbols.txt sizes (0x34, 0x38, 0x58, 0xb4, 0xc4, 0xc, 0x130, 0x24, 0x4, 0x4) sum to exactly 0x3a4 = 0x020c8dd4 - 0x020c8a30 and each starts where the previous ends, so there is no hole and no segment choice.

LOWER EDGE: the promoted dMgJump3DMario_c unit ends at 0x020c8a30 (its last function, _ZN16dMgJump3DMario_cC1Ev, ends exactly there). UPPER EDGE: the unpromoted Player/dMgTrmpln2Mario_c/dMgTrmpln3DMario_c unit starts at 0x020c8dd4 with Trmp2Mario_GetVelocity. Neither edge has a gap.

WHAT IT IS: one static array of three 0x20-byte records at sPuffs and its helpers. The module's static initialiser (__sinit at 0x0212f660, relocs 0x0212f6a0..0x0212f6ac) calls __cxa_vec_ctor(&sPuffs, 3, 0x20, Puff_Nothing, Puff_ElemDtor) and registers Puff_CleanupAll, which calls __cxa_vec_cleanup with the same dtor, so 0x020c8dd0 is the record constructor, 0x020c8dcc its destructor and 0x020c8da8 the array destructor; all three are inside the run. The other seven functions are the pool's draw/update/reset/claim operations; their only data are sPuffNextIndex..021404f6 and sPuffPoolLast (the last record, 0x021404d8 + 0x40).

NO CLASS NAME. The ROM carries no RTTI string or vtable for the record type (build/rtti.json has no entry in this range and the record type has no virtuals), and no source or note names it, so the unit keeps the unit<addr> name rather than an invented class name.

module sinit corroboration: ov006 .init follows .text TU order. The initializer at 0x0212f660, between dMgJump3DMario_c's (0x0212f52c) and the Trampoline Mario unit's (0x0212f6b4), builds sPuffs with __cxa_vec_ctor(C1 0x020c8dd0, D1 0x020c8dcc) and registers 0x020c8da8, this unit's __arraydtor; it touches only this run's .bss, so this TU owns it (folded 2026-10-28, was src/unnamed/ov006/__sinit_ov006_0212f660.c).
